recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured square composition featuring a central photographic window of a woman in a vintage car, framed by bold psychedelic lettering and a structured list of names below.
coreVisualRelationships: The large yellow title arches over the central photographic window.
The photographic subject is framed within the car window, creating a frame-within-a-frame effect.
The red diagonal corner banner balances the top-left against the dark background.
The bottom text block is justified and anchored by geometric red circular icons.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic window is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched yellow title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left red sash, moves to the arched title, drops into the photographic window, and settles on the justified text block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial dark charcoal/black space surrounds the central elements, providing a heavy, grounded feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary title and logo elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for geometric shapes, corner sash, and bullet points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for yellow and red against a low-value, desaturated dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, yellow, red, and white

letterConstructionRules: Title letters are arched along the top edge.
Extreme weight contrast with thick stems and sharp, flared serifs.
The numeral is integrated into a triangular red frame.
Body text is a clean, high-contrast serif with wide tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'R' have exaggerated, liquid-like descenders and counters.
The 'B' has a heavy, bulbous top bowl.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme decorative display paired with a clean, high-contrast classical serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the psychedelic flared serif aesthetic of the 70s.
Matches the high-contrast serif style of the body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a dark charcoal textured background. In the center, place a rectangular photographic window showing a woman with 1970s hair looking out of a vintage blue car window. Add a red diagonal sash in the top left corner and a red triangle frame just above the photo window.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the arched title in a heavy psychedelic yellow font at the top. Add a justified block of names in a white serif font at the bottom, separated by small red dots. Place interlocking red circle icons at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the title arched and yellow?
Is there a red diagonal sash in the top left?
Is the photo framed within a car window?
Is the bottom text block justified with red bullet points?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow title does not touch the edges of the frame.
Check that the red sash is at a 45-degree angle.
Verify the photographic window has a slight inner glow or shadow to suggest depth.
Confirm the body text is perfectly justified.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark square base + Arched psychedelic header + Central photographic window + Justified serif footer list.
